versions.content: On invocation of EthTSyn_GetProtocolParam EthTSyn shall return the following values received in the latest Follow_Up information TLV via argument protocolParam: • cumulativeScaledRateOffset • gmTimeBaseIndicator • lastGmPhaseChange • scaledLastGmFreqChange Member protocolType of argument protocolParam shall be set to STBM_TIMESYNC_ ETHERNET
